command: async (page) => {  const response=await page.request.get(new URL('/api/roster/team_nexus',page.url()).href); const roster=await response.json();  return {status:response.status(),plans:roster.players.map(p=>({id:p.id,dev_focus:p.dev_focus,training_intensity:p.training_intensity,learning_language:p.learning_language,starter:p.starter})),dom:await page.locator('tr').filter({has:page.locator('td span.plink[data-pid="team_kraken_unit_p0"]')}).innerText()}; }
